svg.aria-label: 301 versus 302 redirects, drawn as two sequence diagrams. On the first click both work the same way: the browser asks the shortener for /TjbIC7r, gets a 301 or 302 with a Location header, and then loads the long URL from the website. On the second click, a 301 is served from the browser's cache and the shortener is not contacted, while a 302 sends the browser through the shortener again, so every click can be counted.
svg.title: 301 vs 302 redirects
